### Fully Forgiven
Author: Alexis A. Goring
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/fully-forgiven-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Romans 6:23
Points:
- Overwhelming financial debt mirrors humanity's inability to pay for its own sin.
- Jesus fully paid the debt of human sin through His spotless sacrifice on the cross.
- Believers can approach Jesus directly in prayer, received by God as righteous and redeemed.
- Trusting Christ cancels the penalty of sin and grants the free gift of eternal life.

### Careful Warning to All Who Are Free
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-april-23-2013.html
Passage: Romans 6:16
Points:
- Believers under grace still need sobering warnings so they do not abuse their spiritual freedom.
- A person's conduct is determined by whichever master they yield to and obey.
- Paul presents only two masters: sin that leads to death, or obedience that leads to righteousness.
- Each day presents believers with an active choice between following what is right and doing what is wrong.
